title: Build AI video generation platform with script writing, voiceover, and music

requirements.text: Create a landing page that introduces the platform's capabilities: Sora-powered video generation, cinematic quality output up to 15 minutes, AI script writing, professional voiceover, sound effects, and music integration

quotes: Create a website for long ai video generation which includes, sora video version, cinemation, quality voiceover, script writing, sound effect, music , long 15 minutes cinemation video  creation

acceptanceCriteria: Landing page displays all six core features clearly
Maximum video duration of 15 minutes is prominently mentioned
Visual hierarchy emphasizes cinematic quality and Sora technology

requirements.text: Implement a video project creation workflow where users can input their requirements: video concept, desired length (up to 15 minutes), style preferences, and target audience
acceptanceCriteria: Form accepts project title and video concept description
Duration selector allows values from 30 seconds to 15 minutes
Style preferences include options like documentary, narrative, promotional, artistic
All project data is persisted to backend

requirements.text: Create an AI script writing interface where users can generate or refine video scripts with parameters for tone, pacing, and narrative structure
acceptanceCriteria: Script editor allows text input and editing
Users can specify tone (professional, casual, dramatic, etc.)
Generated scripts include scene descriptions and dialogue where applicable
Scripts are saved with the video project

requirements.text: Build a voiceover configuration module where users can select voice characteristics (gender, accent, tone) and generate professional-quality narration from the script
acceptanceCriteria: Voice selection interface with preview capabilities
Options for male/female voices with multiple accent choices
Tone controls (authoritative, warm, energetic, calm)
Voiceover preview before final generation
Generated voiceover files are linked to the project

requirements.text: Implement a sound effects library browser where users can search, preview, and select sound effects to enhance their video
acceptanceCriteria: Categorized sound effects library (nature, urban, technology, etc.)
Search and filter functionality
Audio preview player for each sound effect
Selected sound effects are associated with the project

requirements.text: Create a music selection interface where users can browse background music tracks by mood, genre, and tempo, with options to customize music for their video length
acceptanceCriteria: Music library categorized by mood (uplifting, dramatic, calm, epic)
Genre filters (orchestral, electronic, acoustic, ambient)
Tempo selection (slow, medium, fast)
Preview player for each track
Music selections are saved with the project

requirements.text: Build a video generation status dashboard that displays progress for Sora-based video rendering, including stages for script processing, voiceover generation, visual rendering, and audio mixing
acceptanceCriteria: Progress bar showing overall generation status
Individual stage indicators (script, visuals, voiceover, sound, music)
Estimated time remaining display
Status updates in real-time as generation proceeds

requirements.text: Implement a video project library where users can view all their created projects with thumbnails, titles, duration, creation date, and status (draft, generating, completed)
acceptanceCriteria: Grid or list view of all user projects
Each project card shows thumbnail, title, duration, and status badge
Ability to filter by status (all, draft, generating, completed)
Click on project navigates to project details

requirements.text: Create a video player and download interface for completed videos, showing the final cinematic output with all integrated elements (visuals, voiceover, sound effects, music)
acceptanceCriteria: Full-featured video player supporting playback controls
Display video metadata (duration, creation date, resolution)
Download button for completed videos
Option to share or export video

requirements.text: Design a cohesive visual theme that conveys professional cinematic quality with a modern, sophisticated aesthetic using a color palette of deep teals, warm golds, and charcoal grays; typography should use a clean sans-serif for UI elements paired with an elegant serif for headings; layouts should emphasize spaciousness and clarity with card-based designs and smooth animations
acceptanceCriteria: Color scheme applied consistently across all pages
Typography hierarchy is clear and readable
Animation transitions are smooth (300ms duration)
Card components use consistent styling with subtle shadows
Interface conveys premium, professional quality

constraints: Maximum video duration must be capped at 15 minutes
All generated content (scripts, voiceovers, videos) must be stored and retrievable
Video generation process must provide clear progress feedback to users
nonGoals: Real-time collaborative editing of video projects
Integration with external video hosting platforms
